content: Kememɨtetewakai 'Etsitɨraxi hamatɨa memu'axɨa
'Ikɨ mekanihɨkɨtɨni 'ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima kepauka 'Aritakexiketsi ti'aitakaku nehamatɨa Wawiruniya memɨyekɨ Kerutsareme temu'axɨa, kemaine kememɨte'ununuiwaxɨ waxapayari:
Pinexi nuiwarieyatsie mieme: Keritsuni, 'Itamaxi hetsiemieme: Tanieri, Rawiri hetsiemieme: Katuxi,
Tsekaniyaxi tɨɨriyamama hetsie mɨmiemetɨkai. Parutsi hetsiemieme: Tsakariyaxi meta xeitsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata teɨteri hamatɨana memayuka'utɨa.
Pakati-Muhawi hetsiemiemete: 'Erihuhenahi mɨkɨ Tserahiyaxi munu'ayatɨkai meta huta tsienituyari teɨteri.
Tsekaniyaxi hetsiemieme: Kahatsieri nu'aya meta haika tsienituyari teɨteri hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
'Arini hetsiemiemete: 'Eweri mɨkɨ Kunatani munu'ayatɨkai meta huta tewiyari heimana tamamata teɨteri hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
'Erami hetsiemieme: Kitsariyaxi 'Atahariyaxi nu'aya, meta teɨteri haika tewiyari heimana tamamata meyupaɨmetɨ hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
Tsepatiyaxi hetsiemieme: Tsewariyaxi Mikaheri nu'aya meta nauka tewiyari hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
Kuhawi hetsiemieme: 'Awiriyaxi Kehieri nu'aya meta teɨteri huta tsienituyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahaika hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
Tserumiti hetsiemieme: Kutsipiyaxi nu'aya meta teɨteri xeitsienituyari heimana haika tewiyari hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
Wewahi hetsiemieme: Tsakariyaxi Wewahi nu'aya meta teɨteri xeitewiyari heimana 'atahaika meyupaɨmetɨ hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
'Atsikari hetsiemieme: Kuhanahani Hakatani nu'aya meta xeitsienituyari heimana tamamata teɨteri hamatɨana memu'axɨa.
'Arunikani hetsiemiemete: 'Eripereti, Keyeri meta Tsemahiyaxi, 'imatɨrieka miemete 'ikɨ nuiwaritsie, meta wahamatɨa haika tewiyari teɨteri menayuka'utɨani.
Wihiwahi hetsiemiemete: 'Utahi, Tsawuri meta teɨteri haika tewiyari heimana tamamata meyupaɨmetɨ wahamatɨa menayuka'utɨani.
Kerutsareme kememɨte'u'axɨa

'Ikɨ 'ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima nekaniwarukuxeɨrieni 'aki haa muhane 'aurie 'Ahawa hayaritsie meuyekuke, mana tetitetɨ haika tukari tekaniuyurieni. Hikɨ kepauka yunaime teɨteri nemɨwaruti'inɨataxɨ meta mawari wewiwamete, nixeime Rewi nuiwarieya nepɨka'utaxei.

Hikɨ 'ayumieme neniwarukuxeɨrieni 'Eriyetsexi, 'Ariheri, Tsemahiyaxi, 'Erinatani, Kariwi, 'Erinatani, Natani, Tsakariyaxi meta Metsurani, mana memɨtitekai wa'ukiyarima memɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta nekaniwaruta'inieni Kuyariwi meta 'Erinatani mɨkɨ te'ɨkitamete,

mɨkɨ 'Irirú hetsɨa nekaniwarenɨ'ani Katsipiya kiekatari wa'ukiyari hetsɨa. Mɨpaɨ nekatiniwaruhɨritɨani, Hiru meta 'iwamama Katsipiyatsie memanuyetei yunaime, memɨwaretawawirienikɨ te'uximayatamete takakaɨyari tukita.

Kakaɨyari mɨtatsiparewiekaikɨ, xeime 'ixaheri tewiyari metaneyenɨ'airieni yemekɨ rakumaikame Tserewiyaxi titewakame Makiri nu'aya, Rewi nuiwarieyatsie mieme. Hamatɨana meniu'axɨani niwemama meta 'iwamama, meyunaitɨ tamamata heimana 'atahaika mekaniyupaɨmekaitɨni.
Metatsiere mepɨtatsiheyenɨ'airi Katsawiyaxi meta Kitsariyaxi, mɨkɨ Merari nuiwarimama mepɨhɨkɨtɨkai, waniwema mepɨwaraweiyakai meta wa'iwama, yunaitɨ xeitewiyari mepɨyupaɨmekai.

Metatsiere, Rawiri meta 'iparewiwamete meyunaitɨ hipame memɨwarutihɨawekai rewitsixi memɨwaparewiekakɨ, mɨkɨ mekataneyenɨ'airieni huta tsienituyari heimana xeitewiyari meyupaɨmeme teparewiwamete, mɨkɨ mekanaka'utɨarieni kememɨtetetewakai.

Hikɨ, haa 'Ahawa manuyeka heutahurakakɨ tetitetɨ, neniwaruta'aitɨani temɨtahakienikɨ takakaɨyari hɨxie tixaɨtɨ temɨkatehayuyeitɨanikɨ, meta temitawawirienikɨ huyeta tahamatɨa mɨyemiekɨ, tame, taniwema, yaxeikɨata tapiinite ti'ɨwiyatɨ.

Yemekɨ, nepenetitewiyaxɨ ti'aitame hetsɨa xeikuyaxiyari kawayatsixi wahetsie me'utekame newaretawaunike memɨtatsi'aye'unie wahepaɨtsita memɨtatsihe'ɨwiyanikɨ, ti'aitame yatemɨtehahɨawekaikɨri kename Kakaɨyari wa'ɨwiya kemɨ'ane hetsiena yuri memɨte'erie, peru meta kename kemɨ'ane Kakaɨyari memuku'e'eiriwa ha'atɨ 'uximatɨarika wakupitɨwa.
Hikɨ 'ayumieme tekaniuyuhakieni meta tekaniyunenewiekaitɨni takakaɨyari tewawirietɨ mɨtatsi'ɨwiyanikɨ, mɨkɨta kataniu'enieni.
'Arike nekaniwaranayexeiya tamamata heimana huta mawari wewiwamete wa'ukiyarima memakɨne: Mɨkɨ Tserewiyaxi, Katsawiyaxi meta tamamata wa'iwama.

Mɨkɨ wahɨxie huru neniuti'inɨata kemɨreuhapanakai, piinite mɨtipatsietɨka meta memɨteyetua ti'aitame meta 'i'ɨxatsitɨwamete, 'iparewiwamete memɨmamariwawe meta 'ixaheritsixi mana memenenierekai memɨteheyetua piinite Kakaɨyari tukieyatsie timieme.

Nemɨtiuti'inɨataxɨ kemɨrahetekai 'ipaɨ katinipaɨmekaitɨni: xeitewiyari heimana xewi miriyari heimana nauka tsienituyari heimana huta tewiyari heimana tamamata kiruyari pɨrata, piinite pɨratakɨ mɨtiwewiyatɨka haika miriyari heimana haika tsienituyari kiruyari pɨrahetekai, meta huru haika miriyari heimana haika tsienituyari kiruyari,
xeitewiyari huru watsuyari 'atahaika kiruyari mɨrahetekai, meta hutame wurunitse xariteyari witsi'aneneme, huru hepaɨ witsitiyuxexeiyame.

Hikɨ mɨpaɨ nekatiniwarutahɨawe: «Xeme meta piinite Yawé hetsɨa miemete xekanakɨne xepatsietɨ. Pɨrata meta huru 'imikieri kanihɨkɨtɨni Yawé hetsɨa mɨyetuiya kememɨteyuwaɨriya, mɨkɨ Yawé ta'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari hetsiemieme.

Xeme xeketene'ɨwiyani meta xeketene'utani kepaukake hutarieka meti'inɨatsieni Yawé tukieyata Kerutsareme paitɨ, mawari wewiwamete mexɨakate wahɨxie, meta rewitsixi metatsiere 'ixaheritsixi wa'ukiyarima wahɨxie».
Hikɨ mawari wewiwamete yaxeikɨa rewitsixi metenanupiini pɨrata, huru meta piinite hipame mɨtiuti'inɨatsiekai mɨranɨtɨkienikɨ takakaɨyari tukieyata Kerutsareme paitɨ.

Merikɨte tamamata heimana huta tukariyaritsie mexɨakame metseritsie 'Ahawa hayaritsie tekaniyekɨne Kerutsareme tehekɨneka. Ketemɨte'ɨkɨ tahuyeta Kakaɨyari tahamatɨa kaniumiekaitɨni, katane'ɨwiyakaitɨni memɨtatsi'aye'unie meta tenawayamete wahepaɨtsita.
Kerutsareme te'uta'axɨaka haika tukari teni'uxipiekaitɨni.

Naurieka tukaritsie pɨrata, huru, meta hipame piinite teteniuti'inɨata takakaɨyari tukieyata, hikɨ naime teteniyetuani mawari wewiwame Meremuti hetsɨa 'Uriyaxi nu'aya. 'Eriyatsaxi Pinexi nu'aya mana pɨnierekai hamatɨana pakatei, meta rewitsixi Kutsawari Ketsuha nu'aya, meta Nuhariyaxi Winuhi nu'aya.
'Ana tukaritsie naime teteniuti'inɨata kemɨreuhapanakai meta naime teteniuti'inɨata kemɨtipaɨmekai, meta naitɨ kemɨrahetekai kanaka'utsieni.

Hikɨ, Yawé hetsiemiemeta, 'ixaheritsixi takakaɨyari, memehapaniekai 'ari memu'axɨakai mawari taiyariyari mekaniuwewieni meta 'itiya mawariyari yunaitɨ keyupaɨmetɨ memu'axɨa, meniwarutimawa tsikerutsixi tamamata heimana huta, nauka tewiyari heimana tamamata 'ataxewi muxatsi 'ukitsi, haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'atahuta muxatsi 'etsimemɨpepe meta tsipuri tamamata heimana huta.

Meta ti'aitame 'aitsikaya meniyetuani hɨritɨariekate mana memuwetɨkatei wahetsɨa meta mana mukuwexinaruritɨkai hetsɨa 'Eupɨrate 'anutaɨye tau makayuyuipike hepatsie, mɨkɨta naimekɨ meniwaruparewieni teɨteri meta Kakaɨyari tukieya hetsiemieme.
